options.label: Hide while typing
options.description: Hide the cursor when you press a key until the mouse moves

options.label: Hide after inactivity
options.description: Hide the cursor after this many seconds without movement. 0 never hides

options.label: Hide on touch
options.description: Hide the cursor while you use the touchscreen

options.label: Hide on tablet
options.description: Hide the cursor while you use a graphics tablet

options.label: Invisible cursor
options.description: Do not draw the cursor at all

groups.title: Warping
groups.description: Moving the cursor to follow focus

options.label: Disable warping
options.description: Never move the cursor automatically

options.label: Remember position
options.description: Return the cursor to its last position in a window when it is refocused

options.label: Warp on workspace change
options.description: Move the cursor to the last focused window after switching workspace

options.label: Warp on special workspace
options.description: Move the cursor to the last focused window when toggling the special workspace

options.label: Warp back after other input
options.description: Return the cursor to where it was after touch or tablet input

options.label: Default monitor
options.description: Monitor the cursor starts on, for example DP-1

options.label: Edge padding
options.description: Space kept between the screen edge and the cursor

options.label: Zoom factor
options.description: Magnification around the cursor. 1 means no zoom

options.label: Rigid zoom
options.description: Make the zoomed view follow the cursor exactly

options.label: Detached camera
options.description: Let the cursor move within the zoomed view before the view follows

options.label: Disable antialiasing
options.description: Do not smooth the image when zoomed in

options.label: Hardware cursors
options.description: Use the display hardware to draw the cursor. Disable if it flickers

options.label: Hyprcursor themes
options.description: Support the hyprcursor theme format

options.label: Sync GNOME cursor theme
options.description: Apply the cursor theme to gsettings as well

options.label: CPU cursor buffer
options.description: Make hardware cursors use a CPU buffer

options.label: Keep VRR in fullscreen
options.description: Do not schedule extra frames on cursor movement in fullscreen adaptive-sync apps

options.label: Minimum refresh rate
options.description: Lowest refresh rate used for cursor movement when VRR is kept in fullscreen
